about.title: Advancing Innovation Through IP Excellence
about.description: Founded in 2006, Muncy, Geissler, Olds & Lowe, PC is a top intellectual property law firm in the Washington, D.C. area. We provide high-quality, efficient IP services for both domestic and international clients, leveraging a multilingual team with deep expertise in science, technology, and law. Committed to advancing our clients' innovations, we offer tailored solutions to meet diverse industry challenges and adapt to the evolving IP landscape.

services.title: Patent
services.description: Patents are granted for inventions that are novel, non-obvious, and useful — covering new processes, machines, manufactures, compositions of matter, and improvements thereof.

details.heading: Application Drafting
details.body: Our skilled professionals draft high-quality patent applications that accurately describe your inventions, maximizing approval likelihood.

details.heading: Office Action Responses
details.body: Strategic guidance and expert responses to patent examiner objections, advocating effectively for your application's approval.

details.heading: Portfolio Management
details.body: Comprehensive management services including deadline monitoring, portfolio expansion evaluation, and IP asset optimization.

services.title: Trademark
services.description: A trademark is a distinctive sign used to identify and distinguish goods or services — encompassing words, names, logos, slogans, symbols, designs, colors, sounds, and more.

details.heading: Search & Clearance
details.body: Thorough trademark searches assessing availability and registrability, identifying potential conflicts to minimize infringement risk.

details.heading: Application Filing
details.body: Preparation and filing of trademark applications ensuring compliance with all legal requirements for successful registration.

details.heading: Monitoring & Enforcement
details.body: Proactive monitoring services safeguarding your trademarks against unauthorized use, with enforcement strategies to protect your brand.

services.title: Copyright
services.description: Copyright grants exclusive rights to creators of original works — protecting literary, artistic, musical, and dramatic works, as well as software code and architectural designs.

details.heading: Registration
details.body: Registering your original works with copyright offices, providing the strongest available legal protection and enforcement rights.

details.heading: Licensing & Agreements
details.body: Drafting and negotiating copyright licenses, assignments, and agreements to monetize your copyrights while safeguarding your interests.

details.heading: Digital Rights Management
details.body: Guidance on DRM strategies to control distribution and access to digital content, mitigating unauthorized copying and exploitation.

features.title: Global Reach
features.description: Serving corporations, mid-sized businesses, start-ups, and universities globally with tailored IP strategies.

features.title: Prime Location
features.description: Located in the D.C. metro area, minutes from the USPTO — providing convenient and timely support.

features.title: Technical Expertise
features.description: Attorneys with technical and scientific backgrounds, many with prior experience as USPTO patent examiners.

features.title: Cost-Effective
features.description: Committed to delivering top-quality work with efficiency and cost-effectiveness for exceptional results.

features.title: Swift Protection
features.description: Focused on securing intellectual property protection quickly and affordably for our clients.

features.title: Multilingual
features.description: Multilingual proficiency supporting the IP needs of global businesses: English, Español, Deutsch, Italiano, Русский, 繁體中文, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국인.
